landing.h1_lead: Where code and art share a
landing.lede: ZEROxWORK is an online community-cowork. We put together teams of code and design to build ambitious projects, and every member gets free tools to do it.
landing.du_tech_text: Code, logic and systems. The part that structures, automates and makes things work.
landing.du_art_text: Colour, shape, 3D and illustration. The part that gives personality, expresses and makes something worth looking at.
landing.du_caption: a technical name · a creative soul · the point where they cross
landing.how_title: We build teams. We build big.
landing.how_sub: Not a course, not an agency. Real people working side by side on real projects.
landing.step1_text: Join the community and tell us what you do, what you enjoy and where you are at.
landing.step2_text: We match you with people whose skills complement yours: code, design, 3D or Web3.
landing.step3_text: You take ambitious projects all the way, with group feedback and every community tool.
landing.tools_sub: Joining unlocks the community kit. No cost, no small print.
landing.kit1_text: Ready-made bases for frontend, Web3 and 3D so you can start a project in minutes.
landing.kit2_text: Collaborative rooms to organise tasks, files and progress with your team.
landing.kit3_text: Palettes, typefaces, assets and references so everything looks the way it should.
landing.kit4_text: Reusable pieces the community maintains and improves together.
landing.kit5_text: Honest reviews from people who know, from the code to the composition.
landing.kit6_text: Live events to learn, show your work and meet collaborators.
landing.disc_title: Room for everything where tech meets art.
landing.disc_sub: Every wedge of the X is a world. Wherever you come from, you fit in one (or between several).
landing.cta_text: Request your spot at ZEROxWORK. We form teams, share tools and build ambitious projects.
